organization: QuEra Computing / Harvard / MIT / U. Maryland / Caltech / Army Research Lab
notes: Published Nature vol 649 pp39-46 (2026-01-19). Used high-rate [[16,6,4]] qLDPC code to encode 96 logical qubits from 448 physical atoms. Demonstrated 2.14(13)x below-threshold QEC via surface codes in 4-round characterization circuit. Implemented full universal FT stack: physical entanglement, logical entanglement, logical magic state (for T-gate universality), and entropy removal. Below-threshold means error rate decreases as system scales. First demonstration of >48 verified logical qubits anywhere — doubled previous record within 13 months. Atom loss detection plus ML decoding used. CATCH-UP: this milestone predates our scan window (2026-04-26 to 2026-05-12) but was not captured in HW-023 through 031. RELEVANCE TO OUR WORK: At 96 logical qubits this platform could in principle run our chi=3 MERA circuits (16q transport, alpha-fit) in fault-tolerant mode. 4.67:1 physical-to-logical ratio still high but moving toward practicality.
